title: SAM.gov Opportunities → Markdown output
description: One dataset item per notice, plus REPORT.md, REPORT.json and SUMMARY in the default key-value store. Never includes POC email or phone.

results.title: Opportunity notices
results.description: Dataset items: noticeId, title, agency, NAICS, type, postedDate, responseDeadline, award/value, uiLink, descriptionExcerpt, markdown, errorClass.

reportMarkdown.title: Markdown report (REPORT.md)
reportMarkdown.description: Summary table plus one Markdown notice card per opportunity. No POC contacts.

reportJson.title: JSON summary (REPORT.json)
reportJson.description: Compact JSON of notice cards (same fields as dataset, no contact fields).

summary.title: Run summary (SUMMARY)
summary.description: noticesOk, noticesFailed, byClass, apiKeyProvided, keyHint, charged, durationSecs, peakMemoryMb.
